1.description: A reverse 2048 puzzle where the board starts with 2048 tiles instead of tiny numbers. Merge downward, plan your space carefully, and try to work all the way back to 1.

10-minutes-till-dawn.description: Survive waves of monsters in a dark arena where every upgrade changes the rhythm of the run. Build a loadout fast, keep moving, and try to last until the timer runs out.

2048-cupcakes.description: Slide matching cupcakes together to create higher-value treats on a tight grid. It is the familiar 2048 puzzle loop with a sweeter theme and plenty of one-more-try pull.

9007199254740992.description: A super-sized 2048 variant that keeps climbing far beyond the usual end tile. Merge matching numbers, manage the board, and see if you can reach 9007199254740992.

99-balls.description: Aim carefully, fire a chain of balls, and break numbered targets before they crawl too far down the board. Smart angles and rebounds are the difference between a short run and a huge score.

a-small-world-cup.description: A quick soccer challenge where timing and momentum matter more than complicated controls. Knock the ball past your opponent, win rounds, and keep the tiny tournament alive.

achievement-unlocked.description: Explore a small experimental platforming space where almost everything you do triggers an achievement. The joke is part of the game: progress comes from testing weird ideas and finding every little task.

aqua-park-io.description: Race down a giant water slide against other riders while looking for risky shortcuts. Cut corners, bump rivals, and try to splash into first place before the run ends.

backrooms-2d.description: Explore a flat, unsettling maze inspired by the Backrooms while searching for a way out. The danger comes from getting lost, watching your route, and staying calm as the space keeps stretching on.

backrooms-3d.description: Wander through eerie yellow halls and liminal rooms in a first-person Backrooms escape. Listen, navigate carefully, and look for exits before the environment gets the better of you.

bacon-may-die.description: Fight through waves of enemies as a scrappy hero with melee weapons, guns, and fast dodges. The action is silly, punchy, and built for chaotic survival runs.

bad-icecream.description: Guide your frozen character through maze-like stages, collect fruit, and use ice blocks to trap or dodge enemies. It is especially fun in two-player mode, where teamwork can save a messy round.

bad-icecream-2.description: The second Bad Ice-Cream adds more stages, hazards, and fruit-chasing maze puzzles. Break ice, build barriers, and stay just ahead of enemies with a friend or solo.

bad-icecream-3.description: Bad Ice-Cream 3 continues the maze action with new layouts and trickier enemy patterns. Use ice walls creatively, grab every fruit, and keep the round under control.

bad-parenting.description: A browser port of the mobile horror game about an unsettling home and a disturbing family story. Explore carefully, follow the strange events, and let the tension build as the truth comes out.

bad-piggies.description: Build strange vehicles from parts and help the pigs reach the finish or collect objectives. Success comes from tinkering, testing, and laughing at the contraptions that almost work.

baldis-basics.description: Collect notebooks inside a strange school while avoiding Baldi and the other odd characters roaming the halls. It looks simple at first, but the pressure ramps up quickly as each mistake makes escape harder.

ball-maze.description: Play the Amaze-style ball maze game popular from YouTube clips. Swipe or steer the ball through each maze, fill the paths, and solve the route without leaving gaps.

basket-random.description:
Ragdoll basketball for one or two players. First to five buckets takes the match.
Rematches re-roll the teams, so no two games play the same.

basketball-legends.description: Pick a famous-style basketball star and battle through fast arcade matches. Dunk, steal, block, and use special moves to take over the court alone or with a friend.

basketball-stars.description: Play flashy one-on-one or two-on-two basketball with quick steals, deep shots, and powerful dunks. The match flow is fast, simple, and built around timing your moves better than your opponent.

battle-karts.description: Drive into arena combat where racing lines and weapon timing both matter. Grab powerups, chase rivals, and try to survive the chaos long enough to finish on top.

big-flappy-tower-tiny-square.description: Climb a huge tower as a tiny square while flappy-style movement makes every gap risky. Precision, patience, and quick resets are the whole challenge.

big-ice-tower-tiny-square.description: Scale an icy tower packed with slippery platforms, spikes, and tight jumps. The controls are simple, but the level asks for careful movement and steady nerves.

big-neon-tower-tiny-square.description: Dash through a bright neon tower full of hazards, checkpoints, and narrow platforming routes. Each section rewards clean timing and learning from mistakes.

big-tower-tiny-square-2.description: Return to the giant tower for another round of precise square-platforming. Expect tight jumps, traps, checkpoints, and a lot of satisfying almost-there attempts.

block-blast.description: Fit block shapes onto the board and clear lines to keep space open. The puzzle is calm at first, but every placement matters once the board starts filling up.

block-blast-2.description: A second Block Blast entry with the same satisfying shape-fitting puzzle flow. Place blocks, clear lines, and keep enough open space to survive the next pieces.

blood-money.description: An indie horror clicker where earning money comes with increasingly uncomfortable choices. Simple clicking slowly turns into a darker test of how far you are willing to go.

bloxorz.description: Roll a rectangular block across floating platforms and drop it perfectly into the goal hole. Every move changes your shape and footprint, so the puzzle is all about planning ahead.

brawl-stars.description: Jump into quick top-down arena battles inspired by team brawling and character abilities. Choose your fighter, control the map, and outplay opponents in short action-heavy matches.

buckshot-roulette.description: Face a tense tabletop duel built around a shotgun, limited items, and reading the odds. Each round is a risky mind game where one wrong call can end everything.

burrito-bison-launch-alibre.description: Launch Burrito Bison across candy-filled arenas and smash through enemies for speed and cash. Upgrade your power, bounce farther, and try to break through each wall in style.

celeste.description: Climb a dangerous mountain in a precision platformer about dashing, stamina, and clean movement. The challenge is tough but readable, with each screen asking you to master one sharp idea.

celeste-2.description: A small follow-up prototype to Celeste with tight platforming and a grapple-style movement twist. It is short, focused, and built around learning a new rhythm of motion.

cluster-rush.description: Leap across moving trucks in a first-person platforming rush where the ground never stays still. Time your jumps, ride the chaos, and reach the finish before the convoy falls apart.

cookie-clicker.description: Click cookies, buy upgrades, and turn a single bakery into an absurd production empire. The fun comes from watching small gains snowball into ridiculous numbers.

core-ball.description: Launch numbered balls onto a rotating core without hitting the ones already attached. It is a simple timing puzzle that gets tense as the safe spaces disappear.

crazy-cars.description: Drive through open stunt tracks with ramps, loops, and plenty of room to cause harmless mayhem. It is more about playful vehicle control than strict racing lines.

crazy-cattle-3d.description: Drive a cattle around a chaotic 3D arena and slam into others until only one is left standing. Use speed, angles, and physics to knock rivals out before they do the same to you.

crossy-road.description: Hop across roads, rivers, and train tracks while chasing one more step forward. The rules are instant to understand, but the timing gets dangerous fast.

deltarune.description: Enter Toby Fox's story-driven RPG world with turn-based battles, strange humor, and memorable characters. Choices, dodges, and dialogue all shape the rhythm of the adventure.

drift-boss.description: Steer through a floating track where every corner demands the right drift timing. Stay on the road, collect rewards, and see how long you can keep the run alive.

drive-mad.description: Guide a vehicle across unstable obstacle courses filled with ramps, bumps, and awkward physics. The goal is simple, but keeping the car balanced is the real test.

duck-life.description: Train a duck across racing skills, earn coins, and compete in events to become a champion. The loop is part training mini-games, part gradual upgrade climb.

duck-life-2.description: Take your duck around the world and train multiple skills for tougher races. Each practice session improves your chances when the next championship begins.

duck-life-3.description: Evolve and train your duck through new skill paths before entering bigger races. It keeps the familiar training loop while adding more progression choices.

eggy-car.description: Drive a bumpy car while balancing a fragile egg in the back. Gentle throttle control and careful landings matter more than raw speed.

fire-boy-and-water-girl.description: Control two elemental characters through cooperative temple puzzles. Fireboy and Watergirl must avoid opposite hazards, press switches, and help each other reach the exits.

flappy-bird.description: Tap to keep the bird airborne and thread it through narrow pipe gaps. It is brutally simple, instantly readable, and entirely about rhythm.

fnaf.description: Survive nights as a security guard while animatronics move through the building. Watch cameras, manage doors and power, and stay alive until morning.

fnaf-2.description: Return to the night shift with more animatronics, faster pressure, and a mask mechanic. You have to juggle cameras, vents, lights, and audio cues before the office gets overwhelmed.

fnaf-3.description: Monitor a horror attraction haunted by one main animatronic and plenty of hallucinations. Reboot failing systems, track movement, and keep Springtrap away until 6 AM.

fnaw.description: A fan-made survival horror game inspired by the Five Nights formula and Wario-themed characters. Watch the building, react to threats, and survive the night shift.

free-rider.description: Ride a bike across hand-drawn tracks full of jumps, slopes, and traps. Balance and momentum are everything, especially on harder custom-style courses.

funny-shooter-2.description: Blast through waves of strange enemies in a colorful first-person shooter. Unlock weapons, keep moving, and clear arenas packed with ridiculous targets.

geometry-dash-3d.description: Jump, dodge, and react through rhythm-platforming stages presented with a 3D twist. The challenge is all about memorizing hazards and keeping perfect timing.

granny.description: Escape a locked house while a dangerous character listens for every sound you make. Search for items, solve small puzzles, and stay hidden long enough to get out.

grow-a-garden.description: Play a browser entry for the Roblox game Grow a Garden, focused on planting, collecting, and expanding your garden over time. Build up your space, gather rewards, and keep improving what you grow.

gta-2.description: Explore a top-down city in Rockstar's crime sandbox sequel with missions, vehicles, and faction chaos. Cause trouble, earn money, and navigate a busy urban playground from above.

happy-wheels.description: Guide fragile riders through brutal obstacle courses full of traps and physics mishaps. The dark slapstick appeal comes from barely surviving routes that were clearly built to punish mistakes.

hextris.description: Rotate a hexagon to catch falling colored blocks and match groups before the stack grows too high. It turns the matching-puzzle idea into a fast circular reflex test.

learn-to-fly.description: Help a determined penguin launch farther with gliders, rockets, and upgrades. Each run earns money for better gear, turning tiny flights into record-breaking launches.

learn-to-fly-2.description: Upgrade your penguin's launch setup and smash through obstacles on the way to longer flights. It expands the original formula with more equipment and goals to chase.

learn-to-fly-3.description: Build rockets and launch a penguin upward instead of just across the ice. Experiment with stages, boosters, and payloads to reach higher altitudes.

minecraft-1.5.2.description: Play an older browser-accessible Minecraft build focused on mining, crafting, and blocky exploration. Gather resources, shape the world, and settle into the classic sandbox loop.

minecraft-indev.description: Try an early Minecraft-era build with rougher edges and a snapshot-like feel. It is useful for exploring how the sandbox played before later features became standard.

minecraft-parkour.description: Run and jump through Minecraft-themed parkour courses built around block spacing and timing. Every missed jump sends you back to try the route cleaner.

minecraft-tower-defence.description: Defend paths in a Minecraft-themed tower defense setup by placing defenses against incoming waves. Plan your layout, manage upgrades, and stop enemies before they reach the end.

minecraft-zeta-client.description: Launch Zeta Client, an Eaglercraft client for playing Minecraft-style gameplay in the browser. Use it to jump into the blocky sandbox experience without a separate install.

motox3m.description: Race a motocross bike through stunt tracks packed with loops, spikes, and explosive hazards. Fast times require both speed and careful midair control.

motox3m-2.description: Take on more Moto X3M stunt courses with bigger hazards and tighter timing. Flip for time bonuses, land cleanly, and keep the bike moving.

motox3m-3.description: Another round of Moto X3M tracks built for fast retries and risky stunts. The best runs mix aggressive acceleration with smart braking before traps.

motox3m-spookyland.description: Ride through Halloween-themed Moto X3M levels filled with haunted hazards and stunt ramps. Keep your bike balanced while the course throws tricks at every landing.

motox3m-winter.description: Race through snowy Moto X3M stages with icy ramps, traps, and seasonal obstacles. Clean flips and controlled landings are the path to better times.

plants-vs-zombies.description: Defend your lawn by planting sunflowers, pea shooters, and other plants against advancing zombie waves. Each level asks you to build the right lineup before the horde reaches the house.

retro-bowl.description: Coach and play a streamlined football season with quick passing, roster choices, and salary decisions. It captures the fun of arcade football while still letting you manage a team.

short-life.description: Guide a fragile character through trap-filled platforming levels where almost everything can hurt you. Careful timing and a little trial-and-error are the key to reaching the finish intact.

slither-io.description: Grow a snake-like trail by eating glowing pellets while avoiding other players. Cut off rivals, protect your head, and try to become the biggest on the server.

slope-3.description: Roll down a neon slope at high speed while dodging gaps, walls, and sudden turns. The longer you survive, the faster and sharper the track becomes.

slow-roads.description: Cruise through endless generated roads with a focus on relaxed driving rather than racing. Pick a mood, follow the scenery, and let the road keep unfolding.

snow-rider-3d.description: Ride a sled down snowy hills while dodging trees, rocks, and other obstacles. Grab gifts when you can, but survival depends on quick steering.

soccer-random.description: Play unpredictable ragdoll soccer where each round changes the field, players, or physics. Score five goals first, and expect every match to get weird in a new way.

subway-surfers.description: Dash along train tracks, dodge obstacles, and collect coins in a fast endless runner. Quick swipes and sharp reactions keep the chase going.

super-hot.description: Fight through stylized combat encounters where time moves mainly when you move. Plan each step, dodge bullets, and turn split-second action into a puzzle.

the-binding-of-isaac.description: Explore randomly generated rooms in a dark roguelike shooter filled with strange items and dangerous enemies. Each run builds a different character loadout as you push deeper underground.

the-legend-of-zelda-the-minish-cap.description: Adventure through Hyrule in a top-down Zelda quest built around shrinking to tiny size. Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, collect items, and uncover secrets from a new perspective.

the-worlds-hardest-game.description: Move a small square through brutal obstacle rooms while collecting coins and reaching the goal. The challenge is pure timing, route planning, and patience.

tiny-fishing.description: Cast a line, catch fish, and upgrade your gear to reach deeper water. Each trip brings in money for better hooks, longer lines, and bigger catches.

ultrakill.description: A fast retro-styled shooter built around aggressive movement, stylish attacks, and constant momentum. Chain weapons and movement tricks to survive arenas at breakneck speed.

vex.description: Run, jump, slide, and wall-climb through stick-figure platforming stages full of spikes and traps. Each act is a compact test of timing and movement control.

vex-2.description: Vex 2 adds more obstacle courses, checkpoints, and precision platforming challenges. Move quickly, learn each trap, and try to clear every act cleanly.

vex-3.description: Dash through another set of Vex stages with sharper hazards and more complex routes. The game rewards fast reactions, careful jumps, and repeat attempts.

vex-6.description: Take on modern Vex platforming stages with daily-style challenges, skins, and plenty of traps. Precision movement is still the heart of every level.

vex-7.description: Vex 7 continues the stickman platforming series with new acts, hazards, and challenge modes. Expect fast restarts, tight jumps, and timing-heavy obstacle rooms.

vex-8.description: Vex 8 brings more polished stickman platforming with fresh traps and level goals. Learn the layout, move decisively, and chase cleaner clears.

volly-random.description: Play unpredictable ragdoll volleyball where each point can change the court, ball, or player setup. It is quick, silly, and especially good for two-player back-and-forth matches.

word-wonders.description: Solve word puzzles by connecting letters and filling crossword-style boards. It starts simple, then asks for sharper vocabulary and pattern recognition as the levels grow.

wordle.description: Guess the hidden five-letter word in six tries using color feedback after each attempt. Every guess narrows the possibilities, turning vocabulary into deduction.

yohoho-io.description: Battle other pirates on an island arena, collect coins, and grow stronger as you survive. Keep moving, swing at the right moment, and try to become the last pirate standing.

you-vs-100-skibidi-toilets.description: Fight through waves of enemies in a first-person shooter themed around brainrot internet humor. Keep moving, aim fast, and survive the Skibidi-style horde as long as you can.

zombocalypse-2.description: Survive side-scrolling zombie waves with weapons, upgrades, and frantic crowd control. Stay mobile, manage pickups, and cut through the horde as long as possible.

voltan-launcher.description: Launch Voltan, an Eaglercraft client for browser-based Minecraft-style play. It gives you a quick way into the sandbox with client features packaged for the web.
